column3: n. 正式缮写的文件,专注
column5: Her complete engrossment in the experiment made her miss the fire drill.
column6: 她全神贯注做实验,连消防演习都没察觉。

column3: vt. 包围, 环绕
column5: Thick hedgerows environ the garden, shielding it from the coastal wind.
column6: 厚厚的树篱环绕花园,替它挡住海风。

column3: a. 颂扬的, 歌功颂德的, 称赞的
column5: The obituary was warmly eulogistic, tracing fifty years of quiet public service.
column6: 讣告满含褒扬,追述了逝者五十年默默的公职生涯。

column3: a. 公平的, 公平无私的
column5: An evenhanded referee kept the heated derby from boiling over.
column6: 公正的主裁判使这场火药味十足的德比没有失控。

column3: a. 可反对的, 可抗议的
column5: The committee struck one exceptionable passage from the otherwise acceptable report.
column6: 委员会从这份大体可接受的报告中删去了一处惹议的段落。

column3: vt. 想出, 研究出, 设计, 发明
column5: The engineers excogitated a cooling system that needs no moving parts.
column6: 工程师们苦心想出一种无需运动部件的冷却系统。

column6: 肋骨骨折让他每一次浅浅的呼吸都痛彻难当。

column3: a. 游览的, 离题的, 散漫的;移动性的
column5: The diary's excursive entries wander from botany into village gossip.
column6: 日记里散漫的条目从植物学一路岔到村里八卦。

column3: vt. 憎恨, 憎恶, 诅咒;vi. 诅咒
column5: Traditional farmers execrate the herbicide that killed their hedgerow bees.
column6: 传统农户痛骂那种害死树篱蜜蜂的除草剂。

column3: n. 憎恶, 诅咒, 被咒骂的人(或事)
column5: The new tax drew universal execration from shopkeepers and farmers alike.
column6: 新税招致店主和农民异口同声的咒骂。

column3: vt. 删除, 修订, 使纯洁
column5: The school edition expurgates the coarse jokes found in the original text.
column6: 学生版把原著里的粗俗笑话删得干干净净。

column3: v. 即席演说, 即兴演奏, 当场作成
column5: When the teleprompter failed, the senator had to extemporize her closing remarks.
column6: 提词器失灵,参议员只得即兴发挥结束陈词。

column3: a. 可救出的, 可解救的
column5: Mediators argued the dispute was still extricable through quiet diplomacy.
column6: 调停者认为这场争端仍可借低调外交化解。

column3: a. 懦弱的, 无精神的, 胆小的
column5: The mountain rescue team is no place for the fainthearted.
column6: 山地救援队绝不是胆小者能待的地方。

column3: n. 愚钝, 昏庸, 愚蠢言行;愚昧
column5: The memo's breathtaking fatuity astonished even the most patient managers.
column6: 这份备忘录愚蠢得惊人,连最有耐心的经理也咋舌。

column3: n. 吹毛求疵的人
column5: Every workshop has one faultfinder who never offers a solution.
column6: 每个车间都有一个光挑刺却从不出主意的人。

column3: vt. 庆祝, 庆贺
column5: The dean came to felicitate the team on their unexpected tournament win.
column6: 院长亲自来祝贺球队出人意料地捧得锦标。

column3: a. 节日的, 祭日的, 欢乐的

column6: 广场上灯笼高挂、乐队巡行,一派节日气象。

column3: a. 应罚款的;可罚款的, 该罚款的
column5: Parking in the loading zone is finable under the new city ordinance.
column6: 依据新的市政条例,在装卸区停车会被处以罚款。

column3: a. 多扁石的, 多菖蒲的, 凋萎的, 松软的
column5: The flaggy turf of the moor makes every step feel uncertain.
column6: 荒野上松软的草皮让人每一步都踩不踏实。

column3: n. 平板货车, 平板车

column6: 黎明时分,两台吊车把巨型变压器吊上等候的平板车皮。

column3: a. 虚华的

column6: 她浑身名牌招摇炫耀,让低调的同事颇为尴尬。

column5: The interns footled away the whole morning on coffee and idle gossip.
column6: 实习生们喝咖啡、扯闲篇,一上午就这么荒废了。

column6: 市长突然辞职,似乎预示执政联盟内部更大的麻烦。

column3: vi. 结果实;vt. 使结果实, 使肥沃
column5: Careful pruning helped the neglected orchard fructify again after years of decline.
column6: 精心修剪让荒废多年的果园重新挂满果实。

column3: a. 羽毛生齐的, 发育完全的, 有充分资格的
column5: After two seasons of training she became a full-fledged member of the crew.
column6: 经过两个赛季的训练,她成了队里正式的合格队员。

column3: vt. 擦亮, 研磨, 磨光
column5: The museum spent a year furbishing the old armor for display.
column6: 博物馆花了一年时间擦亮整修这批古盔甲用于展出。

column3: n. 笨拙, 不老练, 无礼
column5: His gaucherie at state dinners became a running joke among journalists.
column6: 他在国宴上的笨拙失礼成了记者们的老笑柄。

column3: n. 几何学者
column5: The geometrician proved the theorem with one elegant construction.
column6: 几何学家用一道优雅的作图证明了这个定理。

column3: n. 杀菌剂;杀菌剂

column6: 诊所每接诊一位病人后都用杀菌剂擦拭所有台面。
